scientific_integrity: Exact global upper-envelope dual inequality and strict optimizer uniqueness are proved; finite random-schedule experiments are checks only. The Gramian and minimum-energy identity use standard linear control facts. No independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to distinct strictly positive diagonal decay rates, unit-gain coordinate actuators, exactly one active preselected channel at any time, continuous time with no switching penalty or dwell constraint, fixed horizon and Euclidean worst-case terminal target. No result for coupled dynamics, multiple active channels, implementation on a fixed time grid or stochastic uncertainty. External historical priority remains uncertain.
title: Unique ordered switching for minimax diagonal actuator scheduling
